title: Exploring the Molecular Interaction Between NR2E3 and NR1D1 in Retinitis Pigmentosa: A Docking and Molecular Dynamics Study.
authors: Vafaeie, Farzane; Mohammadpour, Mojtaba; Etesam, Shokoofeh; Zarifi, Shahnaz; Yari, Abolfazl; Nikandish, Malihe; Hashemzadeh, Hassan; Hajiabadi, Mohammad Reza; Miri-Moghaddam, Ebrahim
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过分子对接和MD模拟分析NR2E3突变对NR1D1蛋白互作的影响，但对象为蛋白-蛋白互作而非蛋白-DNA互作，方法可迁移性有限。
abstract: BACKGROUND AND AIMS: Retinitis pigmentosa (RP) is a hereditary retinal disorder that gradually leads to vision loss due to photoreceptor cell degeneration. This study aims to investigate the clinical features and genetic underpinnings of RP within a large Iranian family. Our focus centered on mutations in the NR2E3 gene, which plays a critical role in the development and maintenance of the retina. METHODS: Twenty-five family members showed symptoms of RP, and fourteen of them underwent clinical examinations conducted by geneticists and ophthalmologists. The DNA samples of five individuals diagnosed with RP from the family were subjected to whole-exome sequencing (WES) as part of the study. The candidate variant identified through WES was subsequently confirmed using bidirectional sequencing in additional family members. Additionally, in silico analysis, including molecular modeling, protein-protein docking, and molecular dynamics simulation (MD), was employed to assess potential pathogenic effects associated with the candidate variants. RESULTS: Ophthalmic examination revealed night blindness, which is a common symptom among affected individuals. Genetic analysis identified a homozygous missense variant (c.934G>A/p.R311Q) in NR2E3 exon 6, which co-segregates with other affected family members. Furthermore, molecular docking analysis indicated potential disruption in the binding affinity between NR2E3 and NR1D1 proteins. In-depth, molecular dynamics analysis, considering parameters such as RMSD, RMSF, and hydrogen bonding, revealed notable differences between normal and mutant protein complexes. CONCLUSION: Exploring the molecular interaction between NR2E3 and NR1D1 provides new insights into the pathogenic mechanism of the p.R311Q mutation in RP.
abstract_zh: 背景与目的：视网膜色素变性（retinitis pigmentosa, RP）是一种遗传性视网膜疾病，由于感光细胞退化逐渐导致视力丧失。本研究旨在调查一个大型伊朗家系中RP的临床特征和遗传基础。我们重点关注NR2E3基因的突变，该基因在视网膜的发育和维持中发挥关键作用。方法：25名家庭成员表现出RP症状，其中14人接受了遗传学家和眼科医生进行的临床检查。作为研究的一部分，对该家系中5名诊断为RP的个体的DNA样本进行了全外显子组测序（whole-exome sequencing, WES）。通过WES鉴定的候选变异随后在其他家庭成员中通过双向测序进行确认。此外，采用计算机模拟分析，包括分子建模、蛋白质-蛋白质对接和分子动力学模拟（molecular dynamics simulation, MD），以评估候选变异相关的潜在致病效应。结果：眼科检查显示夜盲症，这是受影响个体中的常见症状。遗传分析鉴定出NR2E3外显子6中的一个纯合错义变异（c.934G>A/p.R311Q），该变异与其他受影响家庭成员共分离。此外，分子对接分析表明NR2E3和NR1D1蛋白之间的结合亲和力可能受到破坏。深入的分子动力学分析，考虑RMSD、RMSF和氢键等参数，揭示了正常和突变蛋白复合物之间的显著差异。结论：探索NR2E3和NR1D1之间的分子相互作用为RP中p.R311Q突变的致病机制提供了新见解。
